label: Require Manager Approval
name: POS Profile-posa_exchange_require_approval

label: POS Item Exchange
name: Sales Invoice-posa_item_exchange

label: Offline Invoices (v14 setting)
name: POS Profile-posa_enable_offline_invoices
description: Kept from v14. Either tick turns offline mode on; untick this one to use only Enable Offline Mode.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_section
label: Fine Dining
description: Table service features for fine dining. Each one can be switched on or off; with Enable Fine Dining off the POS works as before.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_covers
label: Ask Number of Guests (Covers)
description: Asks the number of guests when a table is chosen; shown on the order, kitchen tickets and pre-bill.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_seats
label: Seat Numbers on Items
description: Each item gets a seat number (0 = shared), so the kitchen and the bill know who ordered what.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_modifiers
label: Item Modifiers
description: Choices such as doneness, sides and paid add-ons, set up in POS Modifier Group.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_courses
label: Courses with Hold / Fire
description: Items get a course (POS Course). Courses marked Hold Until Fired go to the kitchen only when the waiter fires them.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_void_control
label: Void / Comp with Reason
description: Removing or reducing an item already sent to the kitchen needs a reason (POS Void Reason), is logged in POS Void Log and sends a VOID ticket to the kitchen. Comp makes an item free with a reason.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_prebill
label: Pre-Bill (Guest Check)
description: Prints the bill for the table before payment, marked as not a tax invoice. Never sent to FBR.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_floor_plan
label: Floor Plan and Table Moves
description: The floor with live table status (Seated, Ordered, Waiting, Bill, Cleaning); open an order from its table, move it to another table, merge tables, move items between orders, hand a table to another waiter. Tables are placed by their Layout Position (X, Y, Width, Height).

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_table_cleaning
label: Tables Need Cleaning After Payment
description: A paid table shows Cleaning until someone marks it Available on the floor plan.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_split_bill
label: Split Bill
description: Split an order into separate checks by seat or by item, or print equal shares on the guest check.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_service_charge
label: Service Charge
description: Adds a Service Charge row (% of the net total) to dine-in orders. Not added to sales made offline.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_service_charge_min_covers
label: Service Charge From Guests
description: 0 = every dine-in order; e.g. 6 = parties of 6 or more

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_tips
label: Tips
description: The waiter or cashier adds a tip (amount or %) before payment; it is collected with the bill and posted to the Tips Account.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_tips_account
label: Tips Account
description: Usually a liability account (tips payable to staff)

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_expo
label: Expo (Pass) Screen
description: The Expo page (/desk/fd_expo) shows each table's courses: held, cooking, ready, served. The pass marks a course served.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_kds_item_bump
label: Kitchen: Finish Single Items and Recall
description: On the kitchen display a cook taps an item when it is done (the ticket is Ready when all are); Recall brings back a finished ticket.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_prep_minutes
label: Kitchen Target Minutes
description: 0 = off. Tickets turn amber at 75% of the target and red past it. An item's own Prep Minutes win.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_86
label: 86 List (Unavailable Dishes)
description: Dishes marked 86 (from the kitchen display or the POS) cannot be ordered; every terminal is told at once.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_allergens
label: Allergens
description: Allergens on items (Item > Allergens, list in POS Allergen) and the guests' allergies on the order. Matching items are flagged on the kitchen ticket and the waiter is warned.

label: Guest Allergies
name: Sales Invoice-posa_allergies
description: Comma separated, e.g. Peanuts, Gluten

label: Prep Minutes
name: Item-posa_prep_minutes
description: Kitchen target for tickets with this item (fine dining)

label: Unavailable Today (86)
name: Item-posa_86
description: Set from the kitchen display or the POS; such items cannot be ordered

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_reservations
label: Reservations and Waitlist
description: POS Reservation: bookings with table, time, guests, deposit; walk-ins on the waitlist. The floor shows Reserved before a booking; Seat opens the order with the guests and allergies.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_guest_profiles
label: Guest Profiles
description: VIP, preferences, allergies, birthday and anniversary on the Customer, with visits, average spend and favourite dishes, shown when the guest is chosen.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_feedback
label: Guest Feedback
description: The guest check prints a link and QR code to a short feedback form (/pos_feedback); answers are in POS Guest Feedback.

label: Preferences
name: Customer-posa_guest_preferences
description: e.g. window table, sparkling water, no ice

label: Allergies
name: Customer-posa_guest_allergies
description: Comma separated; copied to the order when this guest is chosen

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_waiter_offline
label: Waiter App Works Offline
description: Needs Enable Offline Mode (Offline and Devices tab). The waiter app keeps the item catalogue on the tablet; when the Wi-Fi drops, Make KOT keeps the order on the tablet and sends it to the server (and the kitchen) as soon as the connection is back.
